mapper.select: SELECT A.SUN , A.JUNPYOID , A.KERATYPE , A.J_BNUM , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHER ELSE A.J_COMPANY END AS J_COMPANY , A.GUBUN1 , CASE WHEN A.OWEIGHT = 0 THEN A.IWEIGHT ELSE A.OWEIGHT END AS OWEIGHT , A.FIRSTWEIGHT , FORMAT(CONVERT(DATETIME, A.FIRSTTIME),'HH:mm') AS FIRSTTIME , A.SECONDWEIGHT , FORMAT(CONVERT(DATETIME, A.SECONDTIME),'HH:mm') AS SECONDTIME , A.WEIGHT , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.ICHAGAM ELSE A.OCHAGAM END AS OCHAGAM , A.J_STATE , A.GUMSUBIGO , B.EMP_NM , C.WEB_FAX_YN FROM MESURING A LEFT OUTER JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS B ON A.GUMSU_SERIAL = B.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C ON C.DEALER_CD = CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHERID ELSE A.J_ASSIGNID END LEFT JOIN JAJAE D ON A.J_SERIAL = D.J_SERIAL WHERE A.J_DATE = '2023-01-13' AND A.KERATYPE != '직송'

SELECT A.SUN , A.JUNPYOID , A.KERATYPE , A.J_BNUM , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHER ELSE A.J_COMPANY END AS J_COMPANY , A.GUBUN1 , CASE WHEN A.OWEIGHT = 0 THEN A.IWEIGHT ELSE A.OWEIGHT END AS OWEIGHT , A.FIRSTWEIGHT , FORMAT(CONVERT(DATETIME, A.FIRSTTIME), 'HH:mm') AS FIRSTTIME , A.SECONDWEIGHT , FORMAT(CONVERT(DATETIME, A.SECONDTIME), 'HH:mm') AS SECONDTIME , A.WEIGHT , CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.ICHAGAM ELSE A.OCHAGAM END AS OCHAGAM , A.J_STATE , A.GUMSUBIGO , B.EMP_NM , C.WEB_FAX_YN FROM MESURING A LEFT OUTER JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS B ON A.GUMSU_SERIAL = B.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C ON C.DEALER_CD = CASE WHEN A.KERATYPE = '입고' THEN A.MAIPCHERID ELSE A.J_ASSIGNID END LEFT JOIN JAJAE D ON A.J_SERIAL = D.J_SERIAL WHERE A.J_DATE = #{jDate} AND A.KERATYPE != '직송' AND ( ('${sKeraType}' = 'ALL' AND 1 = 1) OR ('${sKeraType}' = 'IN' AND A.KERATYPE = '입고') OR ('${sKeraType}' = 'OUT' AND A.KERATYPE = '출고') )
AND D.DAEGUBUN IN (#{sBigCate})
ORDER BY A.SUN
